title: Quenton Nelson trade rumors: Eagles among teams that showed interest in Colts guard

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Quenton Nelson trade rumors: Eagles among teams that showed interest in Colts guard
sources.description: The Philadelphia Eagles were among teams that showed interest in Quenton Nelson before the Indianapolis Colts traded their All-Pro guard to the Seattle Seahawks on Tuesday morning, according to a report from NFL insider Jeremy Fowler.
